% Invented text. A deck whose accent, a yellow on white, serves the page as
% a container: an alert sets in the ink on a mark of the accent itself, and
% the mark breaks with a long alert across its lines.
\documentclass{slides}

\palette[seeds]{ ink = #1C1917, paper = #FFFFFF, accent = #FACC15 }

\begin{document}

\begin{frame}{A Marked Frame}
Plain words and \alert{marked words} close the line.

\begin{minipage}{4cm}
\alert{A longer alert that the narrow box breaks across its lines.}
\end{minipage}
\end{frame}

\end{document}
